thread:
emma: FYI ticket from AcmeCorp — they saw a jump in p95/p99 latency yesterday after we applied the new quantization profile (int8) for their model. They say tail latency doubled for long prompts.
AcmeCorp-SRE: We're seeing lots of 503s and timeouts around 1.2s -> 2.8s p99 for generation endpoints. No change to input patterns. Started after profile change at ~09:10 UTC.
emma: Customer attached traces and sample request IDs: req_93f, req_93g, req_940. Attaching snippets below. They flagged it as Sev-2. Can eng take a look? :alarm_clock:
raj: I'll pick this up — can you paste a single request payload and the model name/version? Also which pool (dedicated/dedicated-reserved/hosted) they're on.
emma: Model: gptx-large-v2, variant: quant-profile-int8-v3, deployed in dedicated pool "dedicated-west-3-acme". Sample request (shortened):
```
{"input": "Summarize the following long doc... (1200 tokens)\n...", "max_tokens": 1024, "temperature": 0.2}
```
marta: Thanks. Early hypothesis: int8 profile introduced slower kernel path for long sequences or calibration fallback causing dequant ops on critical path. Need perf counters from runtime: kv cache hits, kernel selection, and whether we fell back to fp16 for certain layers.
li: Also possible: fp8 vs int8 mixed paths — if calibration wasn't applied consistently, we sometimes insert extra reprojection ops. That spikes per-token time for long contexts.
raj: I pulled traces from infra logs for req_93f:
```
[2026-03-12T09:12:10Z] request START req_93f node=gpu-5
[2026-03-12T09:12:10Z] kernel_select int8_path (slow-path) layer=12
[2026-03-12T09:12:11Z] kv_cache_miss layer=13
[2026-03-12T09:12:12Z] fallback fp16 layer=20 reason=overflow_risk
[2026-03-12T09:12:13Z] request END req_93f latency=2.72s code=200
```
raj: Notable: kernel_select indicates slow-path for int8 and a fallback to fp16 partway through. That matches latency bump.
emma: Customer says this only started after we flipped their profile to int8-v3. They want either a rollback or mitigation ASAP.
marta: Short-term mitigation options:
- Roll the customer back to fp16 quant/profile (pin model variant to fp16)
- Toggle "prefer_fp16_on_fallback": true for that route so fallback happens earlier and avoids expensive reprojections
- Reduce max_tokens or enforce streaming chunking for long prompts (workaround)
We should pick one and run a canary.
li: There's also a calibration issue we saw in int8-v3 where scale factors for attention QK were slightly off for long-tail sequences — that can trigger conservative fallback heuristics. I'll check the calibration logs.
raj: Operational steps I propose:
1) Put customer on a temporary route override to fp16:
```
# console override
route: /v1/generate/acme
model_variant: gptx-large-v2-fp16
force_pin: true
```
2) Re-deploy a canary with int8-v3 but with 'force_static_calibration=true' to verify deterministic path.
3) If canary passes, roll with telemetry flags.
Would anyone object?
emma: Customer approved rollback to fp16 immediately. I've escalated to accounts and informed them.
marta: I'll prepare a quick rollback playbook and the config snippet for the Console. Also will add targeted logs to measure where the slow-path is triggered.
li: I dug into calibration logs for yesterday's calibration job for int8-v3: some calibration batches contained padded examples with very long zero-padding which skewed activation ranges. That can cause inflated scale leading to overflow checks later and fallback. I'll propose a fixed-seed calibration and drop extreme padding samples.
raj: For immediate mitigation, Emma, can you apply the route override? I'll monitor metrics.
emma: Done — route pinned to fp16 at 09:35 UTC. Customer reports p99 dropped back to ~1.1s within 6 minutes. They confirmed 503s stopped. :thumbsup:
raj: Verified on infra dashboards: p95/p99 for that pool returned to baseline. I still see a few regen spikes in logs; adding a watch for fallback events.
marta: Next steps for eng-runtime:
- Add an observer metric 'quant_fallback_count' per model variant (already instrumented but not exported)
- Make the kernel selector log layer decisions when fallback occurs (for offline triage)
- Add a safety path that prefers an early, full-model fallback to fp16 rather than heterogenous layer-wise fallback when long-context tokens are present
li: For model/ML team: re-run calibration with filtered data + fixed seed, generate new quant-profile-int8-v3b and run perf CI on long-context workloads. If metrics look good, we can attempt a progressive rollout with canaries.
emma: Customer requested a postmortem and a timeline once we have root cause and a fix. Can we target a short RCA by EOD?
marta: I'll own the RCA. Initial notes: calibration padding skew -> conservative fallback -> slow kernel path + layer-level fp16 fallbacks = p99 regression. Will include repro steps and perf diffs.
li: Repro steps I'm adding to RCA: exact cal seed, example batch that triggered skew, commands to run calibration locally:
```
# calibration
python tools/quant_calibrate.py --model gptx-large-v2 --data samples/calib_filtered.jsonl --seed 42 --out quant-profile-int8-v3b.json
```
raj: I'll collect the exact req IDs and a condensed log bundle for SRE/Support. Also scheduling an infra-side patch to expose quant_fallback_count in the next minor agent release.
emma: Thanks all — closing the escalation for now since rollback worked. Leaving thread open for RCA updates. :white_check_mark:
